  tagline = 'An entire universe. Once and for all.',
  description = 'The Avengers and their allies must be willing to sacrifice all in an attempt to defeat the powerful Thanos before his blitz of devastation and ruin puts an end to the universe. As the gravest threat the heroes have ever faced, Thanos wields the Infinity Gauntlet and seeks to collect all six Infinity Stones.',
  imageUrl = 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310419663027009739/SGHqXeh8PZJcCDnFiAMuFi/avengers-infinity-war-2018-featured-dKhvDJo9xf9JTQPnNo2H9y.webp',

  worldwideGrossMillions = 2048,
  domesticGrossMillions = 679,
  openingWeekendMillions = 258,
  rtCriticsScore = 85,
  rtAudienceScore = 91,
  verdict = 'hit',
  cardMarketContent = '## Infinity War: The Ultimate Crossover in Cards

Avengers: Infinity War (2018) brought together virtually every MCU hero in one film, making it the ultimate crossover event for card collectors. With the largest cast in MCU history, the potential autograph checklist is staggering.

### Key Sets

The **2018 Upper Deck Avengers: Infinity War** set features the most expansive autograph checklist in MCU card history. Josh Brolin as Thanos, combined with the full Avengers roster, creates an unparalleled collecting experience.

### Market Trends

Josh Brolin (Thanos) autograph cards are the centerpiece — the greatest villain in MCU history. Multi-character cards featuring heroes who were dusted in the Snap carry emotional premium. The sheer scale of the cast makes complete sets extraordinarily rare.',
  keyCards = '- **Josh Brolin as Thanos Autograph** — Greatest MCU villain ($3,000+)
- **Tom Holland "I Don''t Feel So Good" Snap Card** — Iconic emotional moment
- **Robert Downey Jr. Infinity War Auto** — Peak Iron Man era ($6,000+)
- **Chadwick Boseman Infinity War Auto** — Pre-passing card ($12,000+)
- **Six Infinity Stones Complete Insert Set** — Thematic chase set
- **Dual/Triple Auto Cards** — Multi-hero combinations ($5,000+)',
  content = '## The Snap Heard Around the World

Avengers: Infinity War is the culmination of 10 years and 18 films of storytelling. The Russo Brothers achieved the impossible — balancing 30+ major characters across multiple storylines while making Thanos the protagonist of his own twisted hero''s journey. The ending shocked the world and changed blockbuster filmmaking forever.

## The Legacy

- **The Snap** — Half the universe dusted in the most shocking blockbuster ending ever filmed
- **Thanos** — Josh Brolin created the greatest comic book movie villain of all time
- **$2 Billion Club** — Became only the fourth film in history to cross $2 billion worldwide
- **"I Don''t Feel So Good"** — Tom Holland''s improvised line became a cultural phenomenon
- **The Villain Wins** — One of the only major blockbusters where the villain achieves his goal

## Fun Facts

- Tom Holland improvised the "I don''t feel so good" death scene — the script just said "Spider-Man turns to dust"
- The cast was given fake scripts to prevent spoilers — only the Russo Brothers and RDJ knew the full plot
- The Snap was kept secret from most of the cast until they saw the finished film
- Josh Brolin performed all of Thanos''s scenes in a motion capture suit on set with the other actors
- The opening weekend of $258M shattered the previous record by over $50 million

## Viewing Context

Avengers: Infinity War is the **nineteenth MCU film** and the seventh entry in Phase 3. It requires viewing most previous MCU films to fully appreciate, as it draws on storylines from Iron Man, Guardians, Thor, and the Avengers films. It ends on a devastating cliffhanger resolved in Endgame.',
  metaDescription = 'Avengers: Infinity War (2018) — $2.05B box office, The Snap, Thanos, and why this is the most significant MCU card set for collectors.',
  keywords = 'Avengers Infinity War, MCU Phase 3, Thanos, Snap, Infinity Stones, Josh Brolin, trading cards, Marvel cards, box office',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck Marvel Avengers Infinity War cards autograph',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Is Avengers: Infinity War on Disney+?","answer":"Yes, Avengers: Infinity War (2018) is available on Disney+. It is the culmination of 10 years of MCU storytelling and features the devastating Snap."},{"question":"How much did Infinity War make?","answer":"Avengers: Infinity War grossed $2.048 billion worldwide against a $316 million budget, earning $258 million opening weekend — a record at the time."},{"question":"Who dies in Infinity War?","answer":"After Thanos completes the Infinity Gauntlet and snaps his fingers, half of all life in the universe is dusted, including Spider-Man, Black Panther, Doctor Strange, most of the Guardians, and many others. Gamora, Heimdall, Loki, and Vision die before the Snap."},{"question":"What Infinity War cards are most valuable?","answer":"Josh Brolin Thanos autos ($3,000+) are the centerpiece. Chadwick Boseman cards ($12,000+) carry memorial premium. RDJ peak-era autos ($6,000+) and multi-hero combination cards ($5,000+) are also premium."},{"question":"Is Thanos the main character of Infinity War?","answer":"Effectively yes — the Russo Brothers structured the film as Thanos''s hero''s journey. He has the most screen time, the clearest character arc, and achieves his goal by the end. Josh Brolin''s performance is widely considered the best villain portrayal in superhero cinema."}]',
  status = 'published',
  updatedAt = NOW()
WHERE slug = 'avengers-infinity-war-2018'
